_about: Phase 8 draft content for the 5 services. Imported by cms/seed/steps/16-phase8-drafts.ts as DRAFT versions only. Strings starting with [VERIFY] contain a fact or promise the team must confirm; remove the prefix once confirmed. Field names match cms/collections/Services.ts plus the new Phase 8 field `typicalProjects`.

problems.title: Skilled people doing data entry
problems.description: Your team reads documents, forms or images and re-types what they see into another system. It's slow, it's boring, and every re-typed field is a chance for an error.

problems.title: An AI demo that never reached production
problems.description: A proof of concept worked on ten examples and then stalled: no evaluation, no fallback when the model is unsure, and nobody who owns it.

problems.title: Answers buried in your own documents
problems.description: Policies, manuals and past tickets hold the answer, but people still ask a colleague because search doesn't understand the question.

problems.title: No way to tell whether the AI is right
problems.description: Outputs look plausible, but there's no confidence score, no audit trail and no human checkpoint for the cases that matter.

process.name: Discover
process.description: We collect real samples of the documents or questions you deal with and agree on what "accurate enough" means before building anything.
process.deliverable: Problem brief, sample set, accuracy target

process.name: Decide
process.description: We compare approaches on your samples (off-the-shelf APIs, LLMs, custom models) and write down what we chose and why.

process.name: Build
process.description: We build the pipeline with confidence scoring and a human-review path for uncertain results, and demo it on your data every sprint.
process.deliverable: Working pipeline, review UI, weekly log

process.name: Measure
process.description: We run the agreed evaluation set, report accuracy and speed honestly, and list what it would take to improve further.

deliverables.item: Evaluation set and accuracy report on your own data
Decision log explaining every model and vendor choice
Monitoring for accuracy, latency and API cost
Source code in your repository, with documentation

typicalProjects.name: Document and handwriting extraction
typicalProjects.description: Scans or photos in, structured records out, with validation against a reference database. Our prescription OCR prototype is an example.

typicalProjects.name: Knowledge assistant (RAG) over internal documents
typicalProjects.description: Answers questions from your own documents with citations, access control and an evaluation set.

typicalProjects.name: AI feature inside an existing product
typicalProjects.description: Summaries, classification or extraction added to software you already run, behind a feature flag.

problems.title: The product outgrew its first build
problems.description: Pages are slow, every change breaks something else, and the original developers have moved on.

problems.title: Operations run on spreadsheets
problems.description: Orders, bookings or approvals live in shared sheets and inboxes, so nobody sees the whole picture.

problems.title: A new product with no team to build it
problems.description: You've validated the idea and need a production-ready v1 without hiring a full engineering team first.

problems.title: A dashboard nobody trusts
problems.description: Data is spread across tools, numbers disagree, and reports are assembled by hand every week.

process.name: Discover
process.description: We map the workflows and users the product must serve and agree on what success looks like after launch.

process.name: Decide
process.description: We choose the architecture, hosting and data model, including the options we rejected and why.

process.name: Build
process.description: Two-week sprints with a working demo each time, on a staging environment you can click through.

process.name: Measure
process.description: We launch, check speed and usage against the agreed metrics, and plan the next release.

deliverables.item: Architecture decision log and handover docs

typicalProjects.name: Operations platform
typicalProjects.description: One system for orders, inventory, staff or bookings, replacing spreadsheets and disconnected tools. RestaurantOS is an example of the interface work.

typicalProjects.name: SaaS MVP
typicalProjects.description: Accounts, billing, the core workflow and an admin panel: enough to put in front of paying customers.

typicalProjects.name: Rebuild of an existing app
typicalProjects.description: Audit first, then a staged rebuild so the current product keeps running.

problems.title: Two apps, two teams, twice the cost
problems.description: Separate iOS and Android codebases drift apart, and every feature ships twice.

problems.title: Users who aren't comfortable with technology
problems.description: Your customers are older, busy or on patchy connections, and a standard app design loses them.

problems.title: An app stuck in review
problems.description: Store rejections, crashes on older phones and slow releases keep the app from improving.

problems.title: Staff tools that only work at a desk
problems.description: Field or floor staff need the same data on a phone, including when the connection drops.

process.name: Discover
process.description: We test the key journeys with real users on the phones they actually use.
process.deliverable: User flows, device matrix, success metrics

process.name: Decide
process.description: Cross-platform (React Native or Flutter) or native (Swift / Kotlin): we decide on your requirements and write down why.

process.name: Build
process.description: Sprints with test builds on your phone every two weeks through TestFlight and Play internal testing.

process.name: Measure
process.description: Store submission, crash and performance monitoring, and a release plan for the first months.

deliverables.item: iOS and Android apps from one codebase (or native where needed)
App Store and Google Play submission
Accessibility pass (large text, contrast, screen readers)

typicalProjects.name: Customer app for a service business
typicalProjects.description: Bookings, updates and payments for customers and their families.

typicalProjects.name: Staff companion app
typicalProjects.description: A mobile view of your operations platform for staff on the move.

typicalProjects.name: App rescue
typicalProjects.description: Stabilise crashes, clear store issues and set up a reliable release process.

problems.title: People can't find what they came for
problems.description: Support tickets and drop-offs point at the same screens, but nobody has watched users try them.

problems.title: Every screen looks different
problems.description: The product grew feature by feature, with no shared components, so every new screen takes longer to design and build.

problems.title: Engineers guessing at the design
problems.description: Mock-ups miss states, edge cases and mobile layouts, so developers fill the gaps themselves.

problems.title: A demo that doesn't sell
problems.description: The product works, but the interface doesn't make its value obvious in the first minute.

process.name: Discover
process.description: Interviews, analytics and a walkthrough of the current product to find where people get stuck.

process.name: Decide
process.description: Flows and wireframes for the key journeys, tested with users before any visual design.

process.name: Build
process.description: Visual design and a component library in Figma, with every state and breakpoint specified.

process.name: Measure
process.description: We test the design with users again and support engineers during the build.

deliverables.item: Figma design system with components and tokens
High-fidelity screens for desktop and mobile

typicalProjects.name: Product redesign
typicalProjects.description: Research, new flows and a design system for an existing product.

typicalProjects.name: Design system
typicalProjects.description: Tokens, components and documentation shared between design and code.

typicalProjects.name: Dashboard and data UX
typicalProjects.description: Turn dense operational data into screens people can act on. The RestaurantOS interface is an example.

problems.title: A cloud bill nobody can explain
problems.description: Costs grow every month, and nobody knows which service or environment is responsible.

problems.title: Releases that need a hero
problems.description: Deploying is manual, done by one person, and usually on a Friday night.

problems.title: Finding out about outages from customers
problems.description: There's no monitoring or alerting, so problems surface through support tickets.

problems.title: Security and compliance questions you can't answer
problems.description: A customer asks about backups, encryption or access control, and the answer is "we think so".

process.name: Discover
process.description: An audit of your current infrastructure, costs, deployment process and access.

process.name: Decide
process.description: A target architecture sized for where you are now, with the trade-offs written down.

process.name: Build
process.description: Infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and backups, rolled out without downtime.

process.name: Measure
process.description: We compare cost, deployment frequency and incident response with the audit baseline.

typicalProjects.name: Infrastructure audit
typicalProjects.description: A written report on cost, security and reliability, with a prioritised fix list.

typicalProjects.name: CI/CD and monitoring setup
typicalProjects.description: Automated deployments, alerts and dashboards for an existing product.

typicalProjects.name: Cloud migration
typicalProjects.description: Move from servers or another provider to AWS or Azure, in stages.
